user.description:
1. Open [this link]({auth_url}) and immediately open Developer Console in browser (F12).
2. Log in with your Samsung account. After login, you'll see SmartThings page (don't login there, continue below)
 3. Find the **login.do** request in Network tab
 4. Copy the **auth_server_url** and **code** from URL query parameter.
Continue with the button below.
